labels.caption: ALG / OPT on the exact core families of the guard study of Fig.~\ref{fig:guard} (OPT exact; the mean over the 10 policy seeds): (a) F1, the adaptive-lender family of Theorem~\ref{thm:lower}, at $\rho=16$; (b) F2, the same family with $T=96$ under the oblivious safe-site lender (Theorems~\ref{thm:lower} and~\ref{thm:public}), at $\rho=16$; (c) F3, the insurance family of Proposition~\ref{prop:insurance}, at $T=48$ under the eager lender, with its revocable-only limit for $T\to\infty$. The dashed core ratio bound in (a) and (b) is that of Lagged RetroRenting + one-way guard: its per-run bound $(1+\gamma)C_S(T)+\kappa B_{\rm on}(T)$, implied by Theorem~\ref{thm:envelope}, over OPT, the mean over the seeds; it does not bound the other policies. Keys: (a) PD heuristic + one-way guard = PD heuristic (drawn once); Lagged RetroRenting + one-way guard $\approx$ RetroRenting-style, lagged (within 10\%); Marking $\approx$ RR-renew (within 9\%); (b) PD heuristic + one-way guard = PD heuristic (drawn once); Lagged RetroRenting + one-way guard = RetroRenting-style, lagged (drawn once); (c) Lagged RetroRenting + one-way guard = A2, theory $\bar{r}$ (drawn once). In (c), RetroRenting-style, lagged lies off scale (2,600--3,730).
